**Iran, Islamic Republic of: how applications changed.** The extract records 755,347 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 68,635 in 2016, compared with 35,399 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 8.4% lower than in 2019 (38,643). Applications in 2025 were 1.0% higher than in 2024 (35,038). In 2025, the leading destinations were Germany (10,980; 31%), United Kingdom (7,719; 22%), Canada (6,997; 20%). Germany received 31% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 25% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 51%, across 35,735 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 16% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 7.9 percentage points lower than in 2024 (59%).
